summary: Provide proper ordering for all REST endpoints
description:
With the implementation of XD-1864, we need to make sure that the (paginated) data returned from the REST endpoints has proper default ordering.

Up to now we have done client-side ordering in the Admin UI, but with server-side pagination, the server-side should support proper pagination as well.

Eventually, we may even decide to provide more flexible ordering options (ASC vs DESC, sort on different properties etc.), which may be a separate Jira.
As a Spring XD developer, I'd like to port {{aggregator}} module from XD to s-c-s repo, so I can use it as {{processor}} module to build streaming pipeline.
As a QA, I'd like to include acceptance test coverage for _spark-app_ batch job so that I can validate the functionality as part of every CI build.
As a developer, I'd like to upgrade to Reactor 2.0.4 release, so I could leverage the latest improvements and bug-fixes.
